GBR.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

_meta.title: People with mental health conditions (psychosocial disabilities): UN findings by country
_meta.what: For each country, how many UN human-rights recommendations and observations (from the treaty bodies, the special procedures and the Universal Periodic Review) deal with involuntary psychiatric detention or treatment, denial of legal capacity (guardianship, substituted decision-making), and discrimination against people with psychosocial disabilities, with every matching record listed in full. value = number of matching records. This counts UN attention, not the size of the problem: countries that report more often, or receive more country visits, get more records, and a country with no record may simply not have been reviewed on the issue. A record about several countries is listed under each. year = latest record; first_year = earliest.
_meta.matching_rule: Text mentions involuntary/forced/compulsory/non-consensual (or without consent) psychiatric treatment, hospitalisation, placement, admission, commitment, confinement or electroconvulsive therapy; OR legal capacity, guardianship, substituted or supported decision-making, equal recognition before the law; OR psychosocial disability, mental (health) conditions/illness/disorders, persons with mental...; OR UHRI theme "Right to be recognized as a person before the law". Legal capacity and guardianship apply to all disabilities, not only psychosocial; the matched field says which part matched. Matching is on the English text of each UHRI record (plus UHRI tags where stated); every record that matches is kept. Field "matched" shows what matched in each record.
_meta.source: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), Universal Human Rights Index, full dataset export (export-full-en.xlsx, 278244 records, downloaded 2026-10-22)

_meta.note_codes: XKX = Kosovo (UHRI: "Kosovo*"); EUU = European Union (not a country; UHRI lists it as a country concerned).
_meta.document_url_note: document_url is the UN Official Document System link built from the document symbol.
_meta.records_note: This layer was over 4 MB, so each country lists record_ids and the full records (all fields, with text) are in un_psychosocial_disability_records.json, keyed by annotation_id, stored once even when a record concerns several countries. No record was dropped.
